title: Applications Welcome for Catskill Center Residency
content: This little red cabin is perched above a waterfall at the head of Platte Clove in New York's Catskill Mountains. I sketched it using oils and pen-and-ink.The cabin has limited electricity, no running water, an outhouse, a few mice, and plenty of peace and quiet. If you're selected by the jury, you can stay in it for a week-long residency at no charge.They are willing to consider all kinds of creative people, including visual artists, writers and other makers.Deadline for applications is April 6. More information atCatskill Center website.Info about Platte Clove Residency
